display.description: The display name of the real server that Xnest should connect to. If empty, the DISPLAY environment variable is used.

sync.description: Synchronize window and graphics operations with the real server for debugging.

full.description: Utilize full regeneration of real server objects and reopen a new connection upon regeneration.

visual_class.description: Default visual class of the nested server (StaticGray, GrayScale, StaticColor, PseudoColor, TrueColor, DirectColor).

depth.description: Default visual depth of the nested server.

software_screensaver.description: Use the software screen saver instead of the hardware screen saver.

geometry.description: Geometry parameters for the top-level window (e.g., 800x600+10+10).

border_width.description: Border width of the top-level Xnest window.

name.description: Name of the top-level Xnest window.

num_screens.description: Number of screens to create in the nested server.

install_colormap.description: Do direct color map installation by bypassing the real window manager.

parent_window.description: Window ID to use as the root window instead of creating a new one.

display_name_arg.description: The final display number argument passed to Xnest (e.g., ':1'). Must be set if display is not explicitly passed via -display.
